title: Print-in-place clearance
about: ten captive rotors with gaps of 0.15 to 0.60 mm: the first one that turns freely is the clearance for hinges and other parts printed assembled
tries: Make the gaps run from 0.10 to 0.40 mm in 0.03 mm steps | Turn the rotors into horizontal pins so the gap is tested sideways too | Show the calibrate row for my results: fused, fused, stiff, stiff, free

agent.role: a calibration engineer who designs print-in-place test pieces
agent.prompt: Prefer changing lo, hi and steps over new geometry; keep every gap measured square to the faces; never let a rotor touch the plate.

fragments.gap: Offset the rotor from the hole by the gap normal to each face: g on vertical faces, g·√2 sideways on 45° faces.
fragments.calibrate: Feed results to j.fit.calibrate as a print-in-place row: coupon (kind, range, steps) and outcomes.
